description: This file defines utility classes and functions for handling variable-length sequences in RNNs, including the PackedSequence class, and functions for packing and unpacking sequences, padding, and related operations in PyTorch.

classes.name: PackedSequence
classes.description: Class representing a packed sequence for RNN processing, holding sequence data, batch sizes, and optional sorting indices.

methods.name: pack_padded_sequence
methods.description: Function to pack a padded batch of variable length sequences into a PackedSequence object.

methods.name: pad_packed_sequence
methods.description: Function to pad a PackedSequence back into a tensor with padding.

methods.name: pad_sequence
methods.description: Function to pad a list of variable length tensors into a single tensor with padding.

methods.name: unpad_sequence
methods.description: Function to unpad a padded tensor into a list of variable length tensors.

methods.name: pack_sequence
methods.description: Function to pack a list of variable length tensors into a PackedSequence.

methods.name: unpack_sequence
methods.description: Function to unpack a PackedSequence into a list of tensors.
